description: Releases: `protoboard release` refuses a project with check errors, stale outputs or uncommitted changes, then writes the Manufacturing Package (overview, per-unit spec sheet, BOM and ordering list, work order, assembly guide and test plan, manufacturing files, index.html) and a reproducible release manifest.

skills.summary: Cut a release: choose the package units, clear every precondition (check errors, stale outputs, uncommitted changes), run `protoboard release`, and inspect the Manufacturing Package

tools.purpose: A Chromium-family browser (Google Chrome, Chromium, Microsoft Edge or Brave), run headless: the package's documents are laid out, their figures drawn and the PDFs printed with it, through @protoboardai/ext-docs' renderer
tools.install: install Google Chrome, Chromium, Microsoft Edge or Brave (found where each platform installs them), or set CHROME to a browser's executable

operations.summary: Write the Manufacturing Package to release/<version>/ (units from release.units; one folder per unit) with its manifest, after checking the project is clean

version.description: release version (default: the root module's version)

allow-dirty.description: release from uncommitted changes (true/false); recorded in the manifest

check.description: only run the preconditions and report (true/false); writes nothing

operations.summary: Spec sheet: what the unit is, key figures, contents, interfaces (from the model)
Bill of materials: the unit's module breakdown (bom.csv); the root also gets the whole-product ordering list (ordering-list.csv)
Work order: ordering checklist, fabrication orders per custom part, assembly operations from the model
Assembly guide: kit and one step per joint the unit makes
Test plan: first-article inspection, fits and joints, records to capture
